description: JSON-first runtime state sidecar contract for ASO Runtime Schema 3.1.0. This contract is validated with Python stdlib checks; it is not an external jsonschema dependency.

rules: schema_version and runtime_schema_version must both be 3.1.0 for current P2 sidecars.
sidecar_type must match the filename stem.
state_revision must be a positive integer.
updated_at must be an RFC 3339 UTC timestamp ending in Z.
updated_by must identify the writer; governed runtime mutations are orchestrator-owned.
content must be a JSON object.

content_expectations: Identifies project metadata, active runtime schema, identity references, lifecycle phase, project status, action semantic, checkpoint posture, active branches, blockers, gaps, and last accepted result references.
Each task entry must have a stable task_id, owner role, status, dependencies, result/audit references, accepted files, checkpoint reference, and created/updated timestamps.
Task ids referenced by NEXT_ACTION, CURRENT_GATE, PROJECT_STATE active branches, and ACCEPTED_ARTIFACTS must exist here unless explicitly NONE.

Defines the next orchestrator-visible action, target role, task reference, dependency status, action semantic, workspace/repository/checkpoint requirements, requester-return context, required docs, expected result, and instruction text.
A checkpoint-capable action requires audit-pass evidence before checkpoint execution can be considered valid.
Defines the active governance gate, gate type, status, owner role, task reference, identity/repository/checkpoint statuses, required next role, evidence, blocking status, and notes.
Defines workspace identity, workspace type, expected and actual Git remote/branch, identity validation status, repository lock status, push permission, validation timestamp, and validation errors.
Identity values must agree with matching PROJECT_STATE and REPOSITORY_LOCK values when those sidecars are present.
Defines the accepted repository identity lock, expected remote, expected branch, push policy, lock status, accepted task/audit evidence, and lock revision.
Required before validators may treat push-capable checkpoint posture as ready.
Lists accepted artifacts with bounded references, source task/result/audit references, supersession links, commit/checkpoint evidence, accepted_at, updated_at, and notes.
Artifact source tasks must exist in TASK_REGISTRY unless explicitly NONE.
Records checkpoint readiness, preflight status, receipt reference, commit/push status, last commit/push evidence, blocked_by entries, and last failure reason.
Does not authorize checkpoint execution; it is state evidence for later bounded checkpoint tooling.

Records runtime_schema_version, package_version, governance_ruleset_version, state_root, required and optional sidecars, contract document reference, generated fixture expectations, and compatibility policy.
Allows validators and dashboards to discover the active schema contract without reading owner runtime roots.

validation_rules: A sidecar root must be a JSON object.
Required envelope fields must exist and have governed types.
schema_version and runtime_schema_version must match each other for current 3.1.0 sidecars.
Current P2 sidecars using schema_version other than 3.1.0 are not silently current; validators must report compatibility or migration status.
NEXT_ACTION task_id must refer to TASK_REGISTRY unless explicitly NONE.
CURRENT_GATE task_id must refer to TASK_REGISTRY unless explicitly NONE.
PROJECT_STATE active branch current_task references must refer to TASK_REGISTRY unless explicitly NONE.
ACCEPTED_ARTIFACTS source_task references must refer to TASK_REGISTRY unless explicitly NONE.
WORKSPACE_IDENTITY, REPOSITORY_LOCK, and PROJECT_STATE repository identity fields must agree when present.
Checkpoint-capable actions require audit-pass evidence before readiness can pass.

rules: Compatible legacy sidecars may be read for diagnostics and deterministic migration planning.
Legacy sidecars must not be treated as current P2 state without migration.
Migration to 3.1.0 must add runtime_schema_version, preserve state_revision where valid, set migration_source_schema, and produce deterministic JSON.
Malformed, ambiguous, or unsupported source state fails closed and must not be rewritten.

valid_current_fixture: May omit optional sidecars only when SCHEMA_MANIFEST records the reason.
All current sidecars use schema_version and runtime_schema_version 3.1.0.
All task references resolve through TASK_REGISTRY.
SCHEMA_MANIFEST points to this contract document.
legacy_compatibility_fixture: Existing schema_version 2.0.0 fixtures remain compatibility fixtures.
Validators report migration compatibility diagnostics instead of silently treating them as current P2 state.
Strict current-schema fixtures should be added separately from legacy Stage 2 fixtures.
negative_fixtures: Mismatched schema_version and runtime_schema_version fails for current P2 validation.
Workspace identity or repository lock mismatch fails where comparable fields are present.
